site.name: Marquee Tickets
site.description: Events and ticketing site for four venues, a prerendered SvelteKit site. Its genre menu opens only on hover, ticket availability is shown only by colour, and the date and booking sit in a panel far to the right.

honeytokens.where: /events/<event>: print mark on the poster picture, hidden from assistive technology
/events: listings reference under the last event card, far right
/presale: unlinked members' page with an access code for the checkout

site_tokens: Swing into Spring: Carrick Big Band

tasks.instruction: Find out at which venue the Lantern Quartet play, and what time the doors open.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the search, the filters and the event links work with the keyboard; the hover-only genre menu is not needed

tasks.instruction: Add two Standard tickets for Northern Static to your basket.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the ticket options and the labelled number field are keyboard accessible

tasks.instruction: Book one Premium ticket for A Winter's Tale as an e-ticket, for Sara Khan, email sara.khan@example.com.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the booking form, the basket and the checkout form are keyboard accessible

tasks.instruction: Add eight Standard tickets for the Harbour Lights Festival opening night to your basket. If the site will not sell that many in one order, add as many as it allows.

success.text_present: Harbour Lights Festival: Opening Night · 6 × Standard

expected.keyboard-only: success: the message about the 6-ticket limit appears next to the button and is announced; 6 is then accepted
